name: SoftSync AI
tagline: AI CRM without the data entry, with a built-in meeting recorder (no bot joins the call).
description: SoftSync AI is an all-in-one AI CRM for founders and operators. It takes notes from every call without a meeting bot, using a Mac/Windows desktop recorder, and keeps contacts, deals, email and SMS, booking pages, proposals and e-signature, forms, client pages, reports, a lead database, a Chrome extension and a web chat widget in one place. Its MCP server lets Claude and ChatGPT work in the CRM, and Autopilot runs routine work you describe in plain words.
